title: ID0471378-DC/Si-D/SE-[MP/RD170003000] Backend sent stop session but not stopped in charger
description:
Reported behavior/issue: The end customer stopped the session with backends app but the session didn't stop and they couldn't remove the cable. When end customer contacted backend support it says stopped there so the couldn't stop it again. They charge for 30 minuts more before the rebooted the charger and then they could remove the cable.
Session started Mon, 01 Dec 2025 15:08:03 and ended bu OCPP Mon, 01 Dec 2025 15:12:22 but not stopped until Mon, 01 Dec 2025 15:52:37
Please send it to
de Matos Joaquim, Francisco (SI E EU CS TS) because it requires ssh access.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0471378-DC/Si-D/SE-[MP/RD170003000] Backend sent stop session but not stopped in charger CRM:03056000914
additional_info.body:
Dear Magnus,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0471378.
I took over the ticket to analyze the issue of the charging session not being stopped from Backend.
I analyzed the two subsequent charging sessions, and I can see many things not working “normally”:
First session starts at 2025-12-01T15:04:05. It is authorized via RemoteStartTransaction, but after Charging Phase P06 there is no “OCPP send command: StartTransaction”. After 5 seconds we see an outage of communication from the EcoG and a StatusNotification of “secc is offline”. The session is then ended internally by the charger.
The second session starts at 2025-12-01T15:08:26. In this case the OCPP StartTransaction is sent, and at 2025-12-01T15:08:41 we see the first signs of communication outage with EcoG: Outlet is still considered online, comm outage: 5000 ms, max: 5000 ms.
At 2025-12-01T15:12:10 starts the abnormal behavior:
Outlet is offline due to comm outage with EcoG
Outlet is set outoforder and there is a StopCharging event form SECC
StatusNotifications to OCPP are subsequentially sent as Faulted-Unavailable-Charging
Due to the communication outage, we get a timeout error from LEM
Here the abnormal behavior: We send a OCPP StopTransaction, but the reply is just acknowledged form Backend, instead of accepted.
At this point, the charging session is not stopped, even though we had a StopCharging event from SECC, a timeout error from LEM and sent a OCPP StopTransaction.
The customer stated that he tried to stop the session from the Backend app, but in the logs we have no proof of any received RemoteStopTransaction. Customer then called the Backend support, and at 2025-12-01T15:46:44 the Backend sent a Reboot command in order to stop the session.
I believe the original issue is the outage of communication with EcoG. In my eyes, it seems that this communication outage with EcoG affected the sicharge-cp-backend communication with the OCPP Backend: missing StartTransaction in first session, missing confirmation of StopTransaction, RemoteStopTransaction not reaching the charger.
I just opened a R&D ticket to get further analysis of this incorrect behavior. It might be the case that the EcoG KF11 has to be replaced, but I would wait for R&D and EcoG's feedback, in case something else has to be checked from their side.
I will follow up with you as soon as I have feedback.
With kind regards,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0471378-DC/Si-D/SE-[MP/RD170003000] Backend sent stop session but not stopped in charger CRM:03056000914
additional_info.body:
Hello Magnus,
Apologies for the late reply on this ticket.
As per my previous analysis, the root cause of the session not being stopped was identified in a communication outage of the EcoG, triggering an incorrect behavior of the charger. R&D has been working on this topic together with EcoG. A permanent fix will be included in the upcoming
FW v9.0 (expected release CW15)
.
In the meanwhile, R&D released an Hotfix (EcoG layer version 1.4.20) which should solve the origin of the communication outage. This Hotfix has been released via SCB: it is based either on v8.0.5 or v8.1.4, and can be updated via SCB as a normal FW update. This Hotfix installation will only update the EcoG layer, it will not change anything in terms of charger's FW.
Please let me know if you would like to install the Hotfix based on v8.0.5, or would like to wait for FW v9.0.
I will then proceed to close the ticket.
With kind regards,
